exhibition.persistence: Only ordinary four-season choice is stored; late summer and unlock remain in current document memory.

depth.academicCoordinates: Flat panels; no rotation, translation or perspective.

provenance.artBoundary: Mathematical geometry and topic covers are art; cultural stars are not realtime sky or medical evidence.

evidence.mode: Code-led; no approved comp; no FORM seed.
evidence.sourceInspection: Documentation read source and accepted records; no new live-browser measurement.
evidence.verdictScope: Prior review: original five scored findings and introduced390px Print CV obstruction resolved; no open scored findings. Not whole-surface endorsement.
limitations: Synthetic tonal ramps intentionally omitted: source state palettes are authoritative.
notCanonized: Removed broad Know Me work-face shadow.

academicCoordinateCorrection.scope: Flat downward reveal, complete block text, filled nonuniform grid and content-aware normal flow.
academicCoordinateCorrection.reviewState: UI accepted as match/adaptation; documentation persistence was the sole remaining fix. Documentation synchronized here; no new independent verdict claimed.
academicCoordinateCorrection.captureNote: Historical coordinate acceptance; shared desktop.png/mobile.png names were superseded by current homepage captures. No new coordinate review.

evidence.historicalScope: This evidence object records earlier Know Me review. Latest homepage evidence is extensions.homepageSky.evidence; shared desktop/mobile filenames now show the homepage.

academicCoordinates.normalFlow: is-flowing when innerWidth<=700 or blockStage.scrollHeight>viewport-topOffset(); position:relative, top:0, min-height:0, scene height:auto.
academicCoordinates.textIntegrity: flex-shrink:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere; project/honor/book/BUCM descriptions have no hidden or clamped overrides.

homepageSky.scope: Approved code-led extension of existing seasonal academic exhibition; no new world, comp or FORM roll; Know Me preserved.

hero.identity: Original portrait and configured bilingual name; PhD student,Basic Theory of Chinese Medicine,BUCM; Chinese also names School of Chinese Medicine; direct/cv/ link.

projection.visibleMansions: Only projected front-facing points; count varies with rotation and viewport. Native selector contains all28 in four traditional seven-name groups.

dayScenes.autumn: Notched fan-shaped ginkgo,radiating veins and clouds

projection.night: Same28 mansion names and four traditional groups in every season; no fifth celestial group.
projection.fallback: Static inline SVG when JS/canvas is unavailable; art is aria-hidden with semantic controls and disclosure.

discovery.storage: Never write late summer or unlock; ordinary site-season preference retained.
discovery.keyboard: Enter/Space hold; short release activates ordinary Summer; sequential button activation also works.
discovery.heroHeading: Unlock synchronizes the Chinese hero to 在五季变化中， and English to five seasons.; retained through ordinary season/language/theme changes; source four-season heading restored on refresh.

controls.picker: Native select,min-height44px,night-only;29 options including prompt,28 mansions,four optgroups.
controls.disclosure: Native details;positions and motion are composed cultural art,not realtime astronomy.

evidence.reviewMode: Reviewer source/image inspection; all nine opened and sizes checked. Browser/runtime observations parent-reported. Documenter sampled three current images and checked source/record consistency.
evidence.verification: Preview/safe production builds,JS syntax/diff,zero horizontal overflow,empty browser warning/error console,actual UI sequence unlock at desktop/mobile/319,language/theme retention,refresh hide,28 selector entries,manual phase33.043 unchanged.
evidence.holdVerification: Actual research.js prefix in mocked DOM/timers;threshold/release/next-click/cancellation/visibility/keyboard/broken sequence/storage/reset.

Detector ran once earlier;caption additions recorded and Liquid RGB zero false-positive not canonized.
Final targeted11px English five-season spacing received browser QA;no second detector run.
Documentation validation only;no new UI/runtime writes or deployment.

scholarlyDiscoveries.scope: Authorized extension of the seasonal exhibition. Experience at hero; Read at publication map. No new palette, dependency or external requests.

order.trigger: Native word buttons: click, pointer drag, Enter or Space. Default and no-script text stays readable.
order.material: Canvas samples actual rendered glyphs; at most 240 linked points. Finite spring reorganization, up to 4.8 seconds after release. No idle animation.
order.reduction: Static connected figure for 1800ms. Escape, hidden/offscreen, focus mode, blur, resize and print restore the word.

connections.trigger: Two distinct opened public records sharing explicit title terms. Repeating one record never unlocks.
connections.composition: Real paired covers, native details, named shared subject, up to six full-title native cover buttons and measured SVG curves. Three desktop columns; two below650px.
connections.motion: 750ms finite line draw; reduced/manual-off path is static.
connections.reader: Existing native reader, PDF/citation/detail links. Restore focus to map origin on close. A direct map action appears in reader after discovery.
connections.lifetime: Current document memory only, reset on refresh. New public titles join matching subjects automatically.
connections.boundary: Title-based reading aid, not citation relationships or causal/medical evidence.

verification.notes: docs/设计验收简报.md; parent browser checks only, no new independent whole-site verdict.

scholarlyPlay.scope: Concept doors and collaboration drafts remain. The user removed the line field; the subsequent two-origin combination interaction ships as Wuxing Lab under its own brief, with 100 elements and 101 recipes.

conceptDoor.trigger: Whole normalized aliases only. Six concepts with three neighbours each.
conceptDoor.evidence: Up to three real public publications selected from titles in the existing search index. Reading paths, not causal or citation relationships.
conceptDoor.search: Normal results remain; concept-only matches receive a correct status. Native search dialog, close focus restoration and responsive scrolling retained.

collaboration.controls: Four maintained research directions, choose two distinct topics with buttons, keyboard or pointer connection. Editable subject and body, explicit rewrite/reset, copy and visitor-initiated mailto.
collaboration.privacy: Draft stays in the document. No persistence, upload or automatic sending. Language and selection changes preserve edits.
collaboration.palette: Existing Know Me acid and dark contact surface.

verification.scope: Parent implementation and targeted browser checks. No new independent whole-site verdict.

wuxingLab.scope: Creation Lab / Wuxing discovery workbench in the independent /labs/ hub; ordinary extension of the seasonal exhibition. 100 elements and 101 recipes; yin and yang open taiji, the five phases, air and light.
wuxingLab.material: 100 original per-element SVG symbols, 64-unit view boxes, 2-unit current-color strokes with round caps and joins, explicit fills where needed. Existing display/body faces and seasonal variables; no new palette or shadows.
wuxingLab.layout: 1200px maximum; 1.1fr / 1fr bench with 36px gap and 40px side insets. Inventory 4 columns; atlas 8; formulas 2. At 900px: equal bench columns, 22px gap, inventory 3 and atlas 6. At 650px: stacked flow, 18px side insets, inventory/atlas 4 and formulas 1. At 360px: inventory/atlas 3.
wuxingLab.controls: Native disclosure and pressed-state view buttons. Bilingual name search, five families, optional hints, same-item pairs, keyboard/button and desktop drag paths. Atlas details and bench returns receive destination focus and scroll with the Labs route's 130px allowance. Explicit reveal exposes undiscovered formulas; missing ingredients disable loading.
wuxingLab.state: Only discovered recipe IDs persist under wuxing-lab-progress-v1. Versioned restoration discards invalid or unreachable routes and derives known elements. Storage failure is visible; current-language plain-text atlas/formula export remains available. Reset requires an explicit confirmation. Separate from document-only late summer and discoveries, and unsaved collaboration drafts.
wuxingLab.motion: One 460ms gathering and 550ms reveal using cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1). No idle loop. Cancel or omit on view/closure, blur/hidden, offscreen result, printing, focus, manual-off or system reduction. The Labs override retains Creation and Order in focus mode; all three labs are omitted from print. No-script disclosures explain JavaScript is required.
wuxingLab.truth: Recipes explicitly distinguish cultural image, simplified making and system relationship; not chemical equations, medical instructions or new research claims.

editorialAtlas.workbook: 造物实验室-图鉴与公式.xlsx
editorialAtlas.content: Stable element/recipe IDs, bilingual names and descriptions/explanations, recipe relationships and extra unlock IDs, editable comment columns, complete symbols.
editorialAtlas.availability: The lab action downloads the workbook. HTML companion links the workbook and both CSVs; raw JSON is a separate direct artifact. Discovered current-language text export remains a separate in-lab action.
editorialAtlas.handoff: Edited files require author review and deliberate synchronization; no live upload, import or automatic publishing path.
editorialAtlas.sourceIntegrity: Exported JSON equals _data/wuxing_lab.json at this documentation pass; maintained source data was not changed.
editorialAtlas.visualBoundary: Standalone editorial document styling is not a new site palette or type role.

labsHub.scope: Independent /labs/ route within the existing seasonal exhibition. No replacement world, comp, seed, font, palette, shadow vocabulary or framework.
labsHub.navigation: Top-level bilingual Labs entry; Creation, Order, Autonomy native disclosures with at most one open. Default Creation; recognized hash opens its lab. Summary/index updates current link without starting simulation.
labsHub.legacyRoute: Homepage #wuxing-lab, #flow-game and #garden-game redirect to corresponding /labs/ hashes with location.search preserved; concept-door entries target /labs/.

layout.currentLink: Accent underline, ink text; inactive muted, hover accent.

mobileTools.readingDock: Relative normal-flow row before main; width calc(100% - 36px), max-width 450px, margin 18px auto 0, no shadow, controls min-height 44px.
mobileTools.returnAction: Relative normal-flow #to-top after content; inset auto, display block, margin 18px 18px 18px auto.
mobileTools.desktop: Existing floating dock and return action retained.

labsHub.focusAndPrint: Focus mode retains all three labs; entering focus cancels Creation/Order effects and pauses an active Autonomy clock. Print hides interactive labs. Returning or reopening never resumes a paused simulation.
labsHub.controls: Reused exhibition panel/ink/line, gentle control corners, accent pressed selection and native accent focus outlines. Long guides and records are native disclosures.
labsHub.evidence: Source and exported-file-structure documentation scan only; no new live-browser measurements or whole-site verdict. Incumbent review records retain their historical scopes.

orderLab.scope: Order Lab on /labs/; 12 connection boards from 3x3 to 6x6, reusing seasonal exhibition materials.
orderLab.layout: Network first in 1.15fr / 1fr columns with 60px gap; max-width 460px board, 2px line gutters, square tile cells within 6px outer frame. At max-width:650px one column with 18px gap and diagnostics below board.
orderLab.material: Current-color SVG conduits; fixed double-ring spring; connected accent solid paths, disconnected dashed paths, optional crossed unmatched ports. Connected/Turns/Open ports readings come from current engine inspection.
orderLab.controls: Clockwise/counterclockwise pressed mode, R reverse turn, arrow-key navigation, undo, one-tile hint toward one known solution, test flow, retry, next board, collection, confirmed reset.
orderLab.state: principles-progress-v1 retains supported board orientations, moves, hints and collection. Confirmed reset clears flow records, preserving legacy garden fields.
orderLab.motion: 180ms emergence-eased turn; one 300ms reachability pulse delayed by actual breadth-first distance * 40ms, capped at 480ms. No idle stream; closure/offscreen/hidden/blur/print/preference changes cancel effects; reduction/manual-off removes CSS transitions and suppresses pulses.
orderLab.truth: Actual connectivity and open-port diagnostics; hints do not claim an optimal route. Fictional system analogy, not medical evidence.

autonomyLab.scope: Original finite lane-defence game on /labs/; 6 levels with 3 to 5 waves. All artwork and mechanics use the exhibition world.
autonomyLab.layout: HUD, four-guard palette, arena and run controls capped at 900px. Three lanes and six columns; first five columns plantable, last entry-only. Palette remains four across on mobile, controls wrap, guide stacks.
autonomyLab.material: Original current-color SVG guards and threats, durability strokes, upgrade dot, accent pressed choice, actual state HUD and latest-response sentence. No new color family or idle art.

guards.lotus: Attacks targets and stores charge while idle
guards.vine: Blocks and regrows when free of nearby pressure
guards.nexus: Senses nearby damage or crowds, then repairs or slows

autonomyLab.controls: Choose/place, arrow navigation, Enter/Space placement, one upgrade per guard, recycle, explicit wave launch/resume, pause, step, 1x/2x, retry, next level, collection and confirmed clear.
autonomyLab.clock: 350ms ordinary / 180ms double-speed explicit simulation timer; SVG movement follows --td-tick. Each cleared wave returns to build phase awaiting the next explicit launch.
autonomyLab.pause: Closing, offscreen, document visibility change, window blur, beforeprint, and motion/focus/reduction preference changes stop active clock. Returning or reopening never resumes. Reduced/manual-off CSS removes visual transitions while explicit launch/resume/step remains available.
autonomyLab.announcements: Running status aria-live off; paused changes polite. Response count and latest event derive from engine state.
autonomyLab.state: autonomy-lab-progress-v1 stores selected level and best collection marks; refresh restarts current round. Confirmed reset affects this lab alone; legacy garden records remain separate.
autonomyLab.truth: Original fictional plants, threats and values illustrate one aspect of self-regulation; no human-body or treatment simulation.

components.name: Wuxing collection element
components.description: Original SVG identity and readable name on an inherited seasonal collection cell; pressed state selects an ingredient or atlas detail. Preview is a static component, not the game engine.

narrative.northStar: 学术展厅 / 连续空间叙事
narrative.overview:
This site has two related surface families. The main academic pages are a quiet seasonal exhibition: paper-toned fields, serif display headings, readable records, and publications that can be taken from a shelf. The homepage places the researcher beside the argument within one translucent, projected seasonal sky. Know Me at /cv/ is a deliberately independent silver/paper, yellow and black spatial narrative, using original line geometry, large bilingual type, sharp frames and continuous native scrolling. The phrase above records the accepted direction; it is not a newly proposed concept.

The durable relationship is scholarly specificity with an accessible reading route. Exhibition pages keep their established seasonal atmosphere; Know Me keeps its user-pinned line-space opening, academic blocks, cinematic journey, approaching works, birth-year and contact ending. These are separate surface grammars, not interchangeable templates. PRODUCT.md supplies content and access constraints, while the shipped CSS and scripts supply the values below.
keyCharacteristics: Two surface families with explicit token namespaces.
Whole-page seasonal palettes on the exhibition; a stable light/dark neutral frame with seasonal accent on Know Me.
An identifiable researcher and one integrated hemisphere on the homepage, with document-only late-summer discovery.
Original mathematical line geometry and native scroll-driven perspective.
Public-source records, truthful cover provenance, and direct reading alternatives.
Two optional scholarly discoveries: finite typographic reorganization and title-based publication connections with direct reading.
An independent Labs hub with optional creation, connection and local-response experiments in the exhibition world.
Local fonts/assets, bilingual controls, keyboard/touch routes and reduced-motion reading.

rules.name: Surface Boundary
rules.body: Keep the exhibition and Know Me token families separate. A square spatial CV frame is not a replacement for the established exhibition shelf or folio.

rules.name: Day Ink / Night Silver
rules.body: Know Me switches the entire neutral frame between paper/ink and dark/silver. Seasonal accent changes do not replace the daytime ink token.

rules.name: Labs Flow
rules.body: Keep the mobile Labs reading dock before the main content and the return action after it in document flow, and keep the playfield and its actions reachable below the sticky local index. Floating tool treatments remain scoped to the routes and widths that use them.

rules.name: Native Camera
rules.body: Native vertical scrolling advances the spatial scenes. Preserve document scrolling and the direct controls; do not add wheel or touch scroll interception.

rules.name: Material Depth
rules.body: Keep academic coordinates flat with a downward reveal. Projection, overlap, linework and perspective provide depth in the other Know Me scenes. The exhibition shelf may use its existing physical volume shadows; do not restore the removed broad shadow to Know Me cover faces.

rules.name: Editable Atlas
rules.body: Keep complete editorial data separate from discovered visitor progress, retain stable IDs and source explanations, and treat edited downloads as review material until the maintained site data is deliberately synchronized.

rules.name: Explicit Clock
rules.body: Lab simulations start or continue through explicit controls. Context pauses and cleared waves require deliberate continuation; visual reduction keeps the state readable and the step route usable. These original game values illustrate system relationships and local responses without representing human physiology or treatment.

rules.name: Readable Edition
rules.body: System reduction, manual motion-off and focus mode remove long pinned reading and continuous effects. Keep the original records and explicit actions available.

dos: Do use the matching surface namespace and the complete observed mode/season assignments.
Do keep ink text and lines on the light Know Me canvas, silver on dark, and black text on the seasonal accent blocks.
Do preserve the original document records, bilingual chooser initialization, explicit previous/next controls, pause/select/read controls and focus return.
Do retain distinct source labels for verified issue covers, owner-supplied book covers, topic artwork and records without a cover.
Do keep original book pixels and the metadata-defined silhouette crop; put provenance in both the maintained source records and web-image metadata.
Do maintain the shared mobile tool reservation and the readable linear/print paths when extending a scene.
Do preserve the homepage identity, one projected sky, complete 28-option semantic selector and document-only discovery lifetime.
Do keep Labs in the exhibition namespace, its mobile dock in document flow, and each experiment's state and reset scope explicit.
Do preserve the complete atlas's stable IDs, bilingual explanations and editable comments separately from the visitor's discovered collection.
donts: Don't merge the exhibition palettes into the Know Me frame or generalize a page-specific scene into a mandatory global layout.
Don't interpret mathematical geometry as medical evidence or the cultural star chart as a realtime sky.
Don't style generic event-type kickers above cinema headings; the current event kind belongs in the detail paragraph. Retain the explicitly requested SINCE literal.
Don't turn icon-font glyphs or inherited system display faces into a new visual-system rule; extend the local display fonts and inline SVG assets instead.
Don't hide the direct reading routes behind motion, chase-only covers or the opening mark, or fabricate achievements/publication status.
Don't treat the narrow final verdict pass as a fresh whole-surface or live performance endorsement.
Don't add a fifth celestial group or persist the late-summer unlock, or describe the rotating front hemisphere as showing all 28 mansions at once.
Don't restart a paused lab on reopening or imply that an edited atlas download automatically changes the published site.
